title: OCR popup configuration and focus persistence
scope: SIG4A OCR quick popup and dashboard Settings page
goal: Let users configure whether the OCR popup stays visible above other windows after clicking outside it; default to staying visible.

acceptance.case: Config default and round-trip save preserve ocr_popup_always_on_top without changing unknown keys
Settings page exposes OCR Popup section and persists the toggle
Quick OCR popup remains visible when focus moves to another window with default enabled; explicit Escape/Close still exits

gate.rule: Do not mark passed until automated tests, independent Advisor review, and native Windows verification pass.
